Class PointLight

java.lang.Object
lighting.PointLight
All Implemented Interfaces:
LightSource
Direct Known Subclasses:
SpotLight
public class PointLight extends Object implements LightSource
Represents a point light source (e.g., a light bulb). The light emits from a specific position in all directions, and its intensity attenuates over distance. * @author פרויקט מבוא להנדסת תוכנה
